description: The console-only parts of UnityPredict — model authoring, long descriptions, IO config, cross-env diffing — as CLI commands.

novel_features.name: All-logs fan-out for a request
novel_features.description: One command fetches the per-request devLog, the runtime Log.txt, and the engine build log, in order.

novel_features.name: One-command long-description upload
novel_features.description: Publish a model's long description from a Markdown file in one step, including the S3 upload dance.

novel_features.name: Declarative inputs/outcomes
novel_features.description: Define a model's input and outcome variables from a YAML file instead of the console's per-field editors.

novel_features.name: Reverse lookup: models per engine
novel_features.description: List every model built on a given engine.

novel_features.name: Honest auth check
novel_features.description: Validate credentials against the one endpoint that cannot lie about auth.

novel_features.name: Engine concurrency view
novel_features.description: Show how many engine nodes ran in parallel over time, as a table.

novel_features.name: Invoke, wait, download in one call
novel_features.description: Invoke a model with text or file inputs, poll to completion, and pull File outcomes into a directory.

novel_features.name: Cross-environment diff
novel_features.description: Compare a model or engine record across dev and prod, field by field.
